content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Payment Gateway ## slug: payment-gateway ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) (The following fields were added to the Payment Gateway object.) * Field Name: `TouchNet uPay Site ID` * API Name: bt_stripe__TouchNet_uPay_Site_ID__c * Data Type: Text(15) * Field Name: `TouchNet uPay Site URL` * API Name: bt_stripe__TouchNet_uPay_Site_URL__c * Text(255) ::: In Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}}, a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record is synonymous with a gateway account (i.e. {{variable.Product_Stripe}}, {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} etc.) account. Each {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record you create connects your {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} org to one gateway account, in either test or live mode. To have your gateway account in both test and live mode, create two {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} records. There is no limit on the number of {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} accounts you can connect to your org. :::(Warning) (Note on Payment Gateway Records) Do not change your Payment Gateway record from test mode to live mode or vice versa by clicking **Connect to Gateway** or checking/unchecking the {{variable.Field_PG_TestMode}} checkbox. Instead, create a new record for the other mode you wish to enable. ::: ## Supported Payment Gateway Providers Blackthorn supports several {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} providers. The primary {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} providers are [Stripe](/v1/docs/stripe), [Authorize.net](/v1/docs/authorizenet), and [Spreedly](/v1/docs/spreedly). Blackthorn also supports the providers below via one of the primary providers. ### Stripe * Apple Pay * Google Pay * Alipay * Bacs Direct Debit * Bancontact * EPS * iDEAL * Plaid (must be set up in Stripe) * SEPA Direct Debit ### Cybersource * via Spreedly - fully tested ### Spreedly The following Spreedly processors are used by Blackthorn customers. * Braintree * Cardconnect * Elavon * eWAY * Fat Zebra * Litle * Orbital * Payflow Pro * Paypal * Sage {{snippet.PayPal_Fee_Amount}} ### Events and Catalog Checkout Blackthorn also supports two {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} providers that only work with {{variable.Product_Events}} checkout. * TouchNet * CashNet ## First Payment Gateway Record Your first {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record, named "primary" was created automatically during the Setup Wizard. Follow the steps below to locate it. 1. Open the Blackthorn | Payments (Admin) app. 2. Click the Payment Gateways tab. 3. Select All from the list of List Views. 3. Click on the record named "primary". **If you connected to your gateway account in test mode, the {{variable.Field_PG_TestMode}} field will be checked.** The primary {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record includes the following. * The {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Default}} field is checked. *Objects with a {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}} lookup field (such as a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} and {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}) will default to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record with the {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Default}} field checked if the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}} field is blank.* * The Gateway Information section provides all the connection details. *If these fields are blank, the data in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} will not process in the gateway. Do not copy your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} API keys and insert them here as these keys are different than your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} keys (they are OAuth keys). You can only get them by clicking the {{variable.Button_PG_ConnecttoGateway}} button.* ![H_01_07_first payment gateway record](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_07_first%20payment%20gateway%20record.png){height="" width=""} ## Create Payment Gateway Records (for Stripe) * [Instructions for Authorize.net](/v1/docs/authorizenet) ### Create a Payment Gateway for Stripe Each {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account mode (test and live) needs its own {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record. This is to ensure that your data is separated from "Live" and "Test". If you connected to your account in {{variable.Field_PG_TestMode}} during setup, create a new {{variable.Product_Stripe}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record for live mode. ![Create a Live Mode Payment Gateway](https://youtu.be/goq64_EmPzY){height="480" width="640"} 1. Open the Blackthorn | Payments (Admin) app. 2. Click the Payment Gateways tab. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Populate the following fields: * {{variable.Field_PG_PaymentGatewayName}} (required) * {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Provider}} (required) * {{variable.Field_PG_WebhookLabel}} = Name for the webhook URL. This is needed to configure [webhooks](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/quick-start). * {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Default}}= Check this field if you want this as your default {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. *If you have multiple {{variable.Product_Stripe}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s, you can change which one is the default.* * {{variable.Field_PG_TestMode}} = Check this field if you are connecting to your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account in test mode. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 5. Click {{variable.Button_PG_ConnecttoGateway}}. 6. Enter your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} credentials. *Once you sign in, all fields under the "Gateway Information" section in the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record will be filled out.* :::(Info) (Syncing Stripe Data to Salesforce) There won't be data in the Related Lists section. Connecting to your Stripe Account does not automatically sync existing data to Salesforce. If you have data in your Stripe Account that needs to be moved to Salesforce, review the [Historical Sync](/v1/docs/historical-sync) documentation. ::: ## Available and Pending Balances The {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object allows you to track an compare your available and pending balances for both {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. ### Stripe {{variable.Field_PG_StripeBalanceAvailabl}} and {{variable.Field_PG_StripeBalancePending}} These fields are updated via the {{variable.Product_Stripe}}'s Balance.Available or Account.Updated [Webhook Events](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/webhook-event). {{variable.Field_PG_StripeBalaLastUpdated}} This date and time field is updated when the balances are updated, giving you an insight as to when the two balances were last updated. {{variable.Field_PG_HeldInReserve}} This field shows the funds held in reserve due to negative balances on Connected Accounts. {{variable.Product_Stripe}} automatically updates this field via a [webhook](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/webhook-event). ### Salesforce {{variable.Field_PG_CalculateSFBalanceFrm}} This field is for calculating historical transactions that were processed through {{variable.Product_Stripe}} before the balance fields were packaged. {{variable.Field_PG_SFBalanceAvailable}} and {{variable.Field_PG_SFBalancePending}} These fields are automatically calculated based on the related {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. * If the related {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s {{variable.Field_Transaction_BalanceStatu}} = {{variable.Picklist_TransaBalStat_Availab}}, then the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RetainNetAmt}} is rolled up to the {{variable.Field_PG_SFBalanceAvailable}}. * If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s {{variable.Field_Transaction_BalanceStatu}} is {{variable.Picklist_TransaBalStat_Pending}} then the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RetainNetAmt}} is rolled up to the {{variable.Field_PG_SFBalancePending}}. {{variable.Field_PG_StripeBalaLastUpdated}} This date and time field that is updated when the balances are updated. {{variable.Field_PG_BalancesIncorrect}} When this field is checked, it means the {{variable.Field_PG_StripeBalanceAvailabl}} and {{variable.Field_PG_SFBalanceAvailable}} fields, and the {{variable.Field_PG_StripeBalancePending}} and {{variable.Field_PG_SFBalancePending}} fields do not match. Often, they don't match because the timing of the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} webhook and the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} batch process doesn't line up. {{variable.Button_PG_UpdateBalance}} Button Clicking this button forces a daily apex job to update the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and {{variable.Product_Stripe}} available and pending balances immediately. :::(Warning) (**IMPORTANT**) If you have a high Transaction volume, don't click the **Update Balance** button. *You will run into a query limit error.* ::: ![H_01_07_available pending balances_salesforce](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_07_available%20pending%20balances_salesforce.png){height="" width=""} ### Scheduled Apex Job The {{variable.SchBatJob_BalanceUpdate}} scheduled job runs daily. It updates the {{variable.Field_PG_StripeBalanceAvailabl}}, {{variable.Field_PG_StripeBalancePending}}, {{variable.Field_PG_SFBalanceAvailable}}, and {{variable.Field_PG_SFBalancePending}} fields on the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record(s). 1. Navigate to Setup. 2. In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Scheduled Jobs." ![H_01_07_scheduled apex job](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_07_scheduled%20apex%20job.png){height="" width=""} ## Block Amex Payment Methods Some providers, like {{variable.Product_Stripe}}, charge higher fees to use an American Express payment method. To help customers mitigate the extra fees, we added the {{variable.Field_PG_BlockAmexTransactions}} field to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object to block {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s from the REST API that attempt to charge a payment with an American Express card. This field can be used with the following. * {{variable.Product_PayLink}} * {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} * REST API requests (custom front-end code) *Remember to add this field to your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} page layout if you want to use it.* Here's what a customer may see if the {{variable.Field_PG_BlockAmexTransactions}} checkbox = "True" (checked). ![H_01_07_block amex pm](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_07_block%20amex%20pm.png){height="" width=""} ### Payment Gateway Owner - Known Limitation If you have configured a Sharing Rule for the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object, there is a known limitation in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. If the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} {{variable.Field_PG_Owner}} = "Automated Process User", Sharing Rules won't be applied. The work around is to update the {{variable.Field_PG_Owner}} field to reflect another user in your org such as the System Administrator. Read more about this [here](https://trailblazer.salesforce.com/issues_view?id=a1p3A000001YodtQAC){target="_blank"}. ## Delete a Payment Gateway Before you can delete a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}, you must first delete any related {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}}s and {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s from the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. 1. Open the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record and review the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} and {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}s. ![Delete a Payment Gateway 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Delete%20a%20Payment%20Gateway%201.png){height="" width=""} 3. Open a {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record. 4. In the navigation menu, click **Remove From Gateway**. ![Delete a Payment Gateway 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Delete%20a%20Payment%20Gateway%202.png){height="" width=""} 6. The {{variable.Field_PGC_DeletedPaymenGateway}} field will be checked. ![Delete a Payment Gateway 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Delete%20a%20Payment%20Gateway%203.png){height="" width=""} 8. Repeat the process for any other related {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} records. 9. Open a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record. 10. Click **Remove From Gateway**. ![Delete a Payment Gateway 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Delete%20a%20Payment%20Gateway%204.png){height="" width=""} 2. Go back to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record. 3. In the record’s navigation, click **Delete**. ![Delete a Payment Gateway 5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Delete%20a%20Payment%20Gateway%205.png){height="" width=""} The {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record is now deleted. ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-troubleshooting){target=`_blank`} or [FAQ](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-faq){target=`_blank`} page.
